metric_name: 违规行为纠正与补救程序
query: 违规行为纠正与补救程序 违规行为纠正与补救程序 描述企业在发现内部（如非法雇佣）或供应链中（如供应商违反环境或人权要求）出现违规情况时，所采取的即时行动、长期纠正措施及预防复发的流程。 A. 响应流程得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了清晰的“发现-调查-处理”链条（如：立即停职、报警、启动补救方案）。 1分：仅提到“将依法处理”或“会进行整改”，缺乏具体操作步骤。 0分：未说明任何违规处理程序。 B. 机制完备性得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了防止违规复发的长期机制（如：定期审计、修订合同条款、供应商拉黑机制）。 1分：仅披露了针对单一事件的处理，无体系化预防措施。 0分：无相关信息。 最终得分 = 0.5×A+0.5×B 纠正措施 补救程序 违规处置 根因分析 复发预防 供应商拉黑 不合规响应 整改闭环 CAPA corrective action remediation procedure violation handling root cause analysis recurrence prevention supplier blacklist non-compliance response CAPA 发现违规后的即时行动链条是什么（停职、调查、报警、启动补救等）？ 长期纠正与预防复发机制有哪些（审计、改合同、拉黑）？ 程序适用于内部非法雇佣还是供应商违规？ 是否有实际案例说明处理过程？ 是否仅停留在“依法处理”表述？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '违规行为纠正与补救程序'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 发现违规后的即时行动链条是什么（停职、调查、报警、启动补救等）？ 长期纠正与预防复发机制有哪些（审计、改合同、拉黑）？ 程序适用于内部非法雇佣还是供应商违规？ 是否有实际案例说明处理过程？ 是否仅停留在“依法处理”表述？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有政策禁令而无违规后的处理表述；仅有申诉渠道；仅有外部处罚新闻而无企业响应或程序。不得排除“将依法处理”“要求整改”等原则性响应；单一事件的实际处理可支持机制完备性1分。区分：本指标评价违规后的响应、补救与防复发；专项政策是禁令，申诉机制是问题入口，争议事件监控评价外部事件暴露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

OUR PEOPLE / Employee Profile

[Content]
The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.
